summary: 5 UI-facing acceptance criteria (homepage library card layout/geometry/nav-scroll fixes) exercised via named browser checks; all passed. No dedicated backend test files needed since all criteria are pure layout/CSS/client-side-scroll behavior with no new API surface (catalogue data already covered by existing backend wiring).

checks.criterion: The five homepage library cards have a uniform desktop layout at 1600px
checks.name: homepage-library-cards-uniform-1600
checks.evidence: At 1600x1000, all 5 book-card-item-* boxes had equal width/height (diff <=2px), and book-card-price-* / book-card-add-btn-* rows aligned to the same Y across all 5 cards (diff <=3px) despite differing title/description lengths.

checks.criterion: All Add to Bag controls have consistent geometry and selected styling
checks.name: add-to-bag-buttons-consistent-geometry
checks.evidence: All 5 unselected book-card-add-btn-* buttons had equal width/height (diff <=2px). Clicking the first book's button changed label 'Add to bag' -> 'In bag' while position/size stayed within 2px of pre-click geometry and matched sibling unselected button dimensions.

checks.criterion: Clicking Home while already lower on the homepage returns to the top
checks.name: home-nav-click-scrolls-to-top
checks.evidence: Scrolled to books-section (scrollY>200), clicked nav-home-link; window.scrollY settled <=10 while route stayed at '/' (no reload/navigation). Re-verified against public preview URL https://business-wisdom-5.preview.emergentagent.com with same result.

checks.criterion: The homepage brand link also behaves consistently at the same route
checks.name: homepage-brand-link-scrolls-to-top
checks.evidence: Scrolled to audience-section (scrollY>200), clicked nav-brand-link; window.scrollY settled <=10 while route stayed at '/'.

checks.criterion: The corrected card layout remains usable at standard desktop width (1280px)
checks.name: homepage-library-cards-usable-1280
checks.evidence: At 1280x900, document.documentElement had no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth-clientWidth <=2px); all 5 cards' price and add-to-bag button elements were visible and non-overlapping.
